integrity: Proof uses a fully enumerated finite complex, 40 exactly verified free-face collapses, integral homotopy arguments and signed Lefschetz traces. No extrapolation or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite filled square-eight-cycle at tolerance one; no general cycle family theorem. Rational dihedral characters, not integral symmetry lattice. Unindexed prior art and independent validation remain open.
title: The octagonal one-tolerance complex: three two-spheres and a dihedral reflection split
